description:
Resume only the pending assets from an incomplete package installation using a fresh exact signed preview and confirmation.

Recovery uses the same paused lifecycle and requires workspace:packages:apply plus workspace owner or ADMIN authority.

Requires write access when connected with OAuth.

approvalReference.description: Exact approval reference bound into the preview

leaseToken.description: Caller-stable lease token for idempotent apply or recovery

packageId.description: Registered package ID; raw manifests are not accepted

preview.description: Exact signed preview returned by preview_workspace_package

name: recover_workspace_package
